title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. ZAKAT 16414 views Q. Disbursement of zakat 1674 views Q. Is zakah applicable on the money from the sale of land? The land has been sold with the intention to buy a piece of land somewhere else. Also the buyer has not paid all the money yet. 3153 views Q. Charity to Non-muslim neighbours 1907 views Q. I am staying in rented house paying rent of 11000 per month since its forbidded in islam to purchase house on loan and I donot have enough money so that i can purchase house without taking a loan. I had purchased land(present value 9 lacs) 2 years back with the intention of selling it later for purchasing a flat for myself or build a house on that land in future or use it as my retirement savings. 1) Do i need to pay zakat on this land? 2) If answer to 1) is No, last year I kept aside zakat money for this land but not yet given it. Do i need to give that amount or keep it with me ? 2955 views Q. Advance Zakat 1939 views Q. How to calculate zakat on gold ornaments? 5796 views Q. Payment of Zakaat on Amount of a plot which is purchased in installments 1493 views Q. Do we have to pay zakat every year on an amountif after paying once it remains with us. If yes please give references from quran and hadith. 3221 views Q. There is a Muslim school registered by government who is providing Islamic and modern education for Muslims and non-Muslims student and free education for poor students Muslim and non-Muslim. I want to know this school management can get or use zakat, sadaqatul-fitr, chaliswan and chirm-qurbani for education purposes. And that will be jayez? 2032 views Q. A flat in Makkah is occupied for some 6 months during the year commencing Rajab until the Dhul Hajj.During this time the rent is multiplied many times than the routine rent. Is the rental income halal? 1586 views Q. Zakah on solar system 1986 views Q. I have bought a land in the year 2001 for investment purpose. My intention was to sell it and utilize its money for the purpose of building our house whenever we plan to have one since we don?t have our own house yet and are still renting it from outside. Later on, I bought a land and am now building my house on it without selling out the previous land. Now, I have changed my plan to sell that plot and have decided to keep it until, either I decide to sell it or do some sort of business on it. I want to know, (1) Do I have to pay zakat on this land that I bought with the intention to sell and have not sold yet. (2) If so, since when? (3) At what rate per square unit? Kindly advise. 1952 views Q. Is there a zakat on diamond or other precious stones? 4727 views Q. Sadqa money used 3015 views

Answer ID: 12198 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 793/754=B/1430) If you are already possessing wealth equal to nisab (wealth limit prescribed by Shariah) and pay the Zakah every year on 25 Safar, you will pay the zakah of all cash, business materials, camel etc that you will own before 25 Safar. The profit earned during the year will be counted among your wealth and you will have to pay the Zakah of all the wealth. (2) It is dain qawi (strong debt). (3) One can pay advanced Zakah. In case of giving extra, one can deduct the same in the Zakah of the next year. (4) The estimation of Zakah will be made as per the selling price. If it is difficult to have accurate calculations, one can have estimation as well, but one should have the maximum estimation. If the articles are not so much, one should have accurate evaluation. (5) There is no problem. If, before the occurring of the due annual date, the balance comes in your possession, include it in your total wealth and pay the Zakah. If the balance is received after the due annual date of Zakah, you shall pay its Zakah the next year. (6) Deduct the amount of debt (annually 24000) from your wealth and pay the Zakah of remaining wealth. (7) Every partner should pay the Zakah as per his own schedule. If the profits were received before the due date, he should include the same with total wealth and pay the Zakah. And, if anyone received the profits after the due date, he should pay its Zakah on the next due date. (8) You can pay the Zakah after enquiring the person in charge of the accounts in the company. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
